required_interface: recover_orphan_interactive_ops_tasks(limit: int = 10, *, remote_liveness_verifier: callable = None) -> dict[str, Any]

required_invariants.description: Recovered task must return to its specific awaiting claim state (awaiting_antigravity_claim or awaiting_cursor_claim) using awaiting_claim_status_for_task(task), never generic awaiting_claim or awaiting_ide_claim.

If task claim_host or headless_execution_host belongs to remote node (e.g., ralphi-ia-ver-10) and not local host, os.kill must NOT be executed locally. If remote_liveness_verifier is absent or returns non-False, recovery must abort with ZERO database writes.

When inspecting task worktree path, if .git is a file starting with 'gitdir: <path>', resolve the actual git directory path and check if index.lock exists there. If locked, abort with ZERO database writes.

Database updates must use an atomic CAS filter matching task_id, status='claimed', claim_token, lease_until, and revision. If modified_count != 1, recovery must be declared failed for that task to prevent race conditions.
CRITICAL PRE-CONDITION: Active heartbeat (< 180s) or active local PID check must be performed BEFORE any database mutation. If active, abort with ZERO database writes.
